priority_policy.P0: blocks safe continuous operation or can create false/unsafe live state
priority_policy.P2: important optimization or Tier-2 expansion after core maturity

gaps.title: Multiple live-capable entrypoints with different authority semantics
gaps.risk: A runner, scheduler, HTTP route or CLI path can bypass canonical approval, idempotency, readback or retry semantics.
gaps.required_resolution: One canonical production orchestrator; all alternate live paths delegate or fail closed.

gaps.title: No durable unified operational state
gaps.risk: Lost or duplicate work, stale current truth, weak restart recovery and concurrent writer races.
gaps.required_resolution: SQLite WAL operational store, append-only transitions, leases, transactions and evidence export.

gaps.title: Approval models are fragmented and some paths use boolean approval
gaps.risk: Changed or stale payloads can be confused with an approved exact artifact.
gaps.required_resolution: One immutable approval envelope with exact artifact/destination/policy hashes and expiry.

gaps.title: No single transactional live outbox
evidence: canonical runner owns a separate platform ledger
gaps.risk: Dispatch attempt ownership, idempotency, retry, readback and reconciliation are not unified.
gaps.required_resolution: Transactional one-operation-per-entry outbox consumed only by canonical dispatcher.

gaps.title: Current scheduler is not production-safe
evidence: unsupported live actions can return mock SUCCESS
recurring entry becomes permanently dispatched after first tick
registry errors silently become empty queue
gaps.risk: False success, lost recurrence, duplicate or unsafe dispatch, invisible queue corruption.
gaps.required_resolution: Quarantine current live scheduler and replace with durable restart-safe supervisor/window/outbox scheduling.

gaps.title: Unauthenticated in-memory local HTTP live launcher
gaps.risk: Local browser/process can launch live behavior outside durable approval and lose task truth on restart.
gaps.required_resolution: Make server read-only health/status or remove it from production; UI writes decisions/work records only.

gaps.title: Unknown-write protection is not universal
gaps.risk: Blind retry can create duplicate public objects or corrupt reply chains.
gaps.required_resolution: Common adapter attempt/reconciliation contract and durable unknown-write state across all entrypoints.

gaps.title: Model default conflicts with operator intent and is embedded in article code
evidence: operator intends Gemini 3.1 Pro current default
gaps.risk: Silent model downgrade, inconsistent quality and hard-to-audit provider behavior.
gaps.required_resolution: Verify exact current model ID, create model registry/shared gateway, make Gemini 3.1 Pro-class default for intended roles and record effective model.

gaps.title: Continuous live candidate intake is unproven
evidence: cross-domain operation is deterministic local shadow
daily scheduler and sidecars are preparation surfaces
gaps.risk: Content production still depends on manual launch or historical fixtures.
gaps.required_resolution: Durable cursors, window ticks, material-delta wakeups, no-op outcomes and governed assignment integration.

gaps.title: Editorial/visual generalization lacks accepted live cohort
evidence: July 11 RC required multiple editorial and visual repairs
three current review stories are held
gaps.risk: Architecture may remain overfit to a small set of fixtures or one accepted topic.
gaps.required_resolution: Ten-plus shadow packages and diverse live cohorts across five story types.

gaps.title: Tier-1 adapter conformance and recovery are not standardized
gaps.risk: A new platform failure requires ad hoc repair and can produce inconsistent evidence.
gaps.required_resolution: Common adapter interface with platform-specific conformance fixtures, circuit breaker and exact repair/resume operations.

gaps.title: Operational UI is not backed by one durable production truth
gaps.risk: Operator can see stale or partial status and cannot manage incidents/reconciliation from one truth model.
gaps.required_resolution: Integrate V5 with durable work/approval/outbox/incident/model state; no direct adapter call.

gaps.title: Observability lacks correlation, incidents and SLO evaluation
evidence: no durable heartbeat or incident lifecycle
no unknown-write aging or error budget
gaps.risk: The factory can degrade or stall without a trustworthy operational diagnosis.
gaps.required_resolution: Correlated metrics, incident/reconciliation center, circuit breakers and SLO reports.

gaps.title: Performance learning is manual/historical replay only
gaps.risk: The system cannot measure which content improves audience growth or reduce revision burden.
gaps.required_resolution: Exact content identity, scoped metrics adapters/operator assist, cohort rules and governed policy proposals.

gaps.title: Community feedback loop uses mock/manual snapshots
gaps.risk: Discord/community flywheel in the North Star is not operational.
gaps.required_resolution: Scoped readers or operator exports, privacy/redaction, exact story binding and reviewable next-idea proposals.

gaps.title: No accepted seven-day soak or restart/concurrency drills
gaps.risk: One-shot tests cannot establish continuous factory reliability.
gaps.required_resolution: Seven-day shadow soak with forced restart, duplicate tick, provider failure, platform degradation and kill-switch drills.

gaps.title: No diverse repeated supervised live cohort
gaps.risk: Generalization and rolling reliability remain unproven.
gaps.required_resolution: Three-story stage 1 and ten-story/five-type stage 2 supervised cohorts.

gaps.title: Current authority entrypoints contain stale next-task conflicts
evidence: status/next_task_pointer identify the latest historical audit
gaps.risk: Builders can start the wrong chain and revive superseded plans.
gaps.required_resolution: Reconcile AGENTS, CURRENT_CONTEXT, bootstrap, current master plan, maturity ledger and next-task pointer in local closeout.

gaps.title: Monetization and conversion attribution are not first-class operational signals
gaps.risk: The factory may optimize posting volume instead of qualified audience and monetizable value.
gaps.required_resolution: Campaign/CTA registry, conversion events, series/audience tags and governed attribution after identity/metrics foundation.

gaps.title: TikTok and YouTube video/Shorts are incomplete separate modes
evidence: YouTube Community proven but video/Shorts not invoked
gaps.risk: Media expansion remains unavailable but does not prevent Tier-1 text/image maturity.
gaps.required_resolution: Separate video script/asset/render/upload/readback system after Tier-1 acceptance.
